nodes.name: One-step hydrothermal synthesis LDH3@SiCnw
nodes.procedure: The appropriate samples of Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O, and 0.173 g of urea CO(NH₂)₂ and 0.047 g of trisodium citrate (TSC, C₆H₅Na₃O₇) were deposited in 100 mL of PTFE container, 65 mL of deionized water was added, stirred magnetically for 15 min. Then added 80 mg of SiC nanowires and stir again magnetically for 15 min. Obtained mixed homogeneous solution, in a rotating oven at 180°C, and reacted for 24 h. The sample was collected by centrifugal washing and drying. The total feeds of the metal cations were higher loading with Ni:Co:Fe = 2:1:1.
nodes.source_text: The Co-doped NiFe LDH@SiCnw composites with different loadings were prepared by a one-step hydrothermal synthesis... Named as LDH₃@SiCnw, LDH₂@SiCnw, LDH₁@SiCnw, SiCnw.

nodes.name: Epoxy coating preparation
nodes.procedure: The Q235 steel sheets (100 mm×100 mm×1 mm) were used in 400, 600, 1000, and 1200 grid sandpapers for polishing, and then ultrasonically washed in aqueous alcohol for 20 min to obtain a clean and flat surface. Consequently, 1.5 g of epoxy resin and 1.5 g of curing agent were dissolved in 10 mL of ethyl acetate solution, and then 0%, 0.3%, 0.5%, and 0.7% by mass of LDH₂@SiCnw filler were added, and processed by heating and stirring to obtain a homogeneous solution. The solution described above was sprayed onto the polished substrate using a spray gun and the coating was subsequently heated at 120°C for 5 h and 180°C for 1 h to give a cured coating with an average thickness of 100±8 μm.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows pure SiCnw with smooth surface and LDH@SiCnw composites forming 3D porous core-shell structure with LDH nanosheets growing parallel at low loading and vertically at higher loading.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The microscopic morphology of all samples at different magnifications is illustrated in Fig. 1b-d. Initially, the pure SiC has a smooth surface (Fig. 1b).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of LDH@SiCnw show characteristic LDH diffraction peaks at (003) 11.59°, (006) 23.14°, (012) 34.95°, (015) 39.40°, (018) 46.89° matching JCPDS-40-0215, with (003) peak shift after Co doping indicating smaller layer spacing.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystal structures of SiC and LDH@SiC_nw were subjected to X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis, as shown in Fig. 1f. The XRD patterns exhibited characteristic diffraction peaks of LDH...

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR shows SiC TO/LO modes at 803.5 cm⁻¹ and 925.58 cm⁻¹, LDH water stretching at 3440.22 cm⁻¹, bending at 1629.33 cm⁻¹, CO₃²⁻ at 1383.01 cm⁻¹, and M-O/M-OH modes at 654-455 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The FT-IR spectra presented in Fig. 1g provide evidence for the effective formation of LDH on SiC_nw. Consistently across all samples, comparable absorption peaks were observed...

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS of LDH@SiCnw shows Ni, Co, Fe, C, O, Si with atomic ratio Ni2p:Co2p:Fe2p = 2.5:1:1.4 (~20.4% Co matching ~25% feed); binding energies confirm Ni²⁺ (873.2/855.1 eV), mixed Co²⁺/Co³⁺ (Co²⁺:Co³⁺=1:3.3), Fe³⁺ (712.1/723.7 eV), SiC/Si-O-Si, and C species.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS spectra showed the presence of Ni, Co, Fe, C, O, and Si elements in the material (Fig. 2a), where Ni2p: Co2p: Fe2p = 2.5:1:1.4 (about 20.4% Co), which essentially matches the ratio of total metal cations of the input LDH (about 25% Co) since XPS is semi-quantitative.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM reveals core-shell heterojunction with LDH nanosheets on SiCnw (>100 nm diameter), denser LDH at higher loading, SAED confirms crystalline structure, HAADF shows homogeneous Ni/Co/Fe distribution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to Fig. 3, the micromorphological analysis of the composites was carried out using transmission electron microscopy (TEM), supplemented by scanning electron microscopy (SEM)...

nodes.characterization_summary: TGA-DTG of LDH2@SiCnw shows 6.2125% weight loss below 1000°C due to LDH decomposition and 5.9411% weight gain at 1300°C from SiC/LDH oxidation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the TGA-DTG curves analysis of Fig. S2c, the LDH2@SiC_nw composite exhibits excellent thermal stability.

nodes.characterization_summary: VSM shows LDH provides weak magnetic properties with small coercivity and saturation magnetization, SiCnw is non-magnetic.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To verify this result, the VSM hysteresis lines of the tested samples showed that the magnetic properties mainly originated from LDH, pure SiC_nw was not magnetic...
